name: Selfless Love
overview: Scripture reveals selfless love as a sacrificial and humble commitment modeled supremely by Christ, who gave Himself for sinners while they were still unworthy. Believers are called to embody this love by serving others with humility and by loving their neighbors as themselves, reflecting the same self-giving love that seeks the good of others above personal gain. This love is the foundation for Christian relationships, exemplified in the call for husbands to love their wives as Christ loved the church, and it is the greatest expression of love to lay down one's life for friends.
